_comment: All coordinates are pixels in the 962x537 reference map (public/worldmap.png). Edit freely: coast = walkable island outline, regions = biome/danger zones (first match wins), sites = enterable places.

sites.name: Landing Beach
sites.blurb: Where you washed ashore. Splintered deck planks and a cooler full of warm drinks.

sites.name: Survivors' Camp
sites.blurb: Tarpaulins over deck chairs and a cooking fire. The kids who stopped running live here, and they are starting to notice you.

sites.name: Wrecked Hull
sites.blurb: A split section of the ship's hull, picked over by somebody.

sites.name: Broken Lifeboats
sites.blurb: Smashed lifeboats half-buried in the sand.

sites.name: Wildlands Ruins
sites.blurb: Overgrown stonework older than the ship.

sites.name: Forest Hut
sites.blurb: A lean-to hidden under the canopy, someone has been living here.

sites.name: South Rope Bridge
sites.blurb: A rope bridge across the river gorge.

sites.name: Middle Rope Bridge
sites.blurb: The planks creak. Somebody has been mending them recently.

sites.name: North Rope Bridge
sites.blurb: The northern crossing, high over the white water.

sites.name: Tribal Huts
sites.blurb: A cluster of huts built from hull plating and driftwood.

sites.name: Mountain Caves
sites.blurb: A dark mouth in the rock, the air coming out of it is warm.

sites.name: Shadow Marsh Camp
sites.blurb: Platforms on stilts above the black water.

sites.name: Coastal Outpost
sites.blurb: Tents above the tide line, with a good view of the wrecks offshore.

sites.name: Crater Peak
sites.blurb: The volcano smokes. Something is building at its foot.

sites.name: Border Outpost
sites.blurb: Tents and lookouts on the edge of the wastes.
